name: Albuquerque Exotic Woods
old_description: A white application pad used for applying Rubio Monocoat oils. Use it as a stand-alone applicator or as a refill to the Applicator Set. The synthetic scrubby fibers are less absorptive then a rag, allowing for less waste.
about:
Albuquerque Exotic Woods operates a retail location at 1570 Juan Tabo Boulevard Northeast in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The store is open Tuesday through Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. and closed on Sundays and Mondays.

The business stocks exotic hardwoods and carries finishing products such as Rubio Monocoat oils and associated application pads. It also lists a product called Oil Plus Part A in a 100 mL size. In addition to sales, the shop offers woodworking classes, with an epoxy class noted as coming soon.

The company serves woodworkers and hobbyists through its physical storefront and online presence, including an Instagram account under the handle @abq_exotic_woods.
